resources.string: This phone serves its sensors as the channels of an openDAQ device on the Wi-Fi. openDAQ Studio on a computer on the same network finds the phone under device discovery or adds it by its connection string.
Start it to serve the microphone, the accelerometer, the gyroscope, the proximity and light sensors, on Samsung phones the infrared light stream and, when included, the camera.
The phone is not on a network. Join a Wi-Fi network first.

The server keeps running in the background while the app is closed and the screen is off. Stop it here or from its notification. Anyone on the same network can connect, so run it only on a network you trust.
Starts the Camera channel, which serves JPEG pictures. Without it, the channel is inactive. A running camera keeps Android\'s privacy indicator on and uses more battery.
Open this address in any browser on the same network to watch the phone\'s signals and change its settings.
The page only shows; changes are off.
Shows that the phone serves its sensors on the network.
